analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of checklyhq.com/docs crawled 976 pages (100% coverage of discovered scope). Critical issues identified: 54 confirmed broken internal links within documentation, 50% API reference coverage gap across 235 detected API pages, and 46.15% example reliability estimate indicating potential code rot. Freshness metadata present on only 38.11% of pages, limiting change tracking. Overall confidence score 72.89% with link verification at 48.47% due to 47 unverified URLs blocked by authentication or rate limiting.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% of discovered documentation scope (976 pages)
API page detection successful with 235 pages identified, enabling coverage analysis
No repository navigation link breakage (0 repo_broken_links_count)
Topology clearly defined as single-product documentation
Crawl trap detection active, filtering 723 non-documentation URLs
risks: 54 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrading user navigation and trust
50% API reference coverage gap leaves half of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
46.15% example reliability estimate suggests high probability of outdated or non-functional code samples
61.89% of pages lack last-updated timestamps, obscuring content freshness and maintenance status
47 unverified links due to authentication/rate-limiting may hide additional broken links
8.71% SEO/geo issue rate may impact discoverability in search and regional access
Overall confidence at 72.89% with link confidence critically low at 48.47%

prioritized_actions.action: Repair all 54 confirmed broken internal documentation links
Audit and expand API reference documentation to close 50% coverage gap across 235 API pages
Validate and update code examples to improve 46.15% reliability estimate
Implement last-updated metadata on remaining 61.89% of pages for freshness transparency
Investigate 47 unverified links with authentication bypass or manual verification to confirm status

limitations: 47 links unverified due to authentication, rate-limiting, or server blocks; actual broken link count may be higher
Example reliability is estimated via heuristics; actual code execution success requires runtime testing
API coverage calculation depends on detection accuracy; complex API structures may be underreported
External link validity subject to third-party availability at audit time; status may change post-audit
Content quality, accuracy, and completeness not assessed; audit covers structural and technical health only
